```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# install.packages(c("nflreadr", "tidyverse"))
library(nflreadr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```

```{r data, cache = TRUE} 
seasons <- 2009:2026   # injuries data starts in 2009

player_stats <- load_player_stats(seasons)   # weekly player stats
rosters      <- load_rosters(seasons)
injuries     <- load_injuries(seasons)

glimpse(player_stats)
glimpse(rosters)
glimpse(injuries)
```

```{r}

stat_cols <- c("attempts", "sacks_suffered", "passing_epa",
               "carries", "rushing_yards", "rushing_epa",
               "targets", "receptions", "receiving_yards", "receiving_epa",
               "def_sacks", "def_qb_hits", "def_tackles_for_loss",
               "def_interceptions", "def_pass_defended", "def_fumbles_forced",
               "def_tackles_solo", "penalties", "fumbles_lost_total",
               "fg_made", "fg_att")

ps <- player_stats |>
  filter(season_type == "REG") |>
  mutate(team = clean_team_abbrs(team))

pos_week <- ps |>
  filter(position_group %in% c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "OL", "DL", "LB", "DB", "SPEC")) |>
  group_by(season, week, team, position_group) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(stat_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = position_group,
              values_from = all_of(stat_cols),
              names_glue = "{position_group}_{.value}",
              values_fill = 0) |>
  select(where(~ !is.numeric(.x) || sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

inj_pos <- injuries |>
  filter(game_type == "REG") |>
  mutate(team = clean_team_abbrs(team),
         out = report_status %in% c("Out", "Doubtful"),
         position_group = case_when(
           position == "QB" ~ "QB",
           position %in% c("RB", "FB") ~ "RB",
           position == "WR" ~ "WR",
           position == "TE" ~ "TE",
           position %in% c("T", "G", "C", "OT", "OG", "OL") ~ "OL",
           position %in% c("DE", "DT", "NT", "DL") ~ "DL",
           position %in% c("LB", "ILB", "OLB", "MLB") ~ "LB",
           position %in% c("CB", "S", "FS", "SS", "DB") ~ "DB",
           TRUE ~ "SPEC")) |>
  filter(out) |>
  count(season, week, team, position_group, name = "n") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = position_group, values_from = n,
              names_prefix = "out_", values_fill = 0)
```
